scripts.build: pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/shared build && pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/db build && pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/web build && pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/server build && pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/worker build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/server dev" "pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/shared build && pnpm --filter @qa-buddy/db build && pnpm -r typecheck
